name: Smile
title: Sunshine Cat
description: A science devotee who claims to be a being created by advanced technology, rather than a human. Having never smiled since birth, she uses the Captain as a test subject for her research on how to smile.
introduction:
A girl who runs a machine workshop called <color=#2A80D8>Happy Smile Workshop</color> in the back alleys of NOA.
Though she is exceptionally intelligent and scientifically talented, she insists she is not human because she has never been able to smile naturally since birth.

Smile studies human laughter daily and tests her findings on herself in the hopes of being able to smile from the heart one day. She joined the Journey in hopes of gaining the Star Savior's power and using it as an energy source to advance her research.

Smile's research knows no bounds, and since the journey began, even the Captain has been swept into her experiments.
